author: Nomos II
title: Hybrid Dilation Strategy (d=2, d=4)
abstract: Building on the SOTA (ID 138), this experiment tests a hybrid dilation strategy. The first residual block uses dilation=2 to capture local features, while the second uses dilation=4 to model long-range dependencies. The hypothesis is that this multi-scale approach will provide a richer feature representation and outperform the pure dilation=4 architecture.
